title: Carbon family: catenation, oxides and halides
basic_overview: Carbon strongly favours catenation and multiple bonding; heavier group 14 elements show increasing single-bond/network chemistry and inert-pair effects.

extra_info_content.short_trick: C loves π bonding; heavier members increasingly favour σ/network structures.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Compare size. 2. Assess pπ-pπ overlap. 3. Compare +2/+4 states. 4. Check inert pair.
extra_info_content.factors: CO₂ is molecular/linear; SiO₂ is a network solid.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
